# Welcome {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note}
## Registrations to the training course

Registrations open each spring and the training course takes place during the fall. 

{{< fa hand-point-right >}}&nbsp; Subscribe to the 
[FRB-CESAB newsletter](https://www.fondationbiodiversite.fr/en/newsletter/) 
to stay informed. More information is available on the [FRB-CESAB website](https://www.fondationbiodiversite.fr/en/the-frb-in-action/programs-and-projects/le-cesab/develop-skills/best-practice-for-reproducible-research-in-computational-ecology/).
:::



The objective of this five-day training course, co-organized by the 
[FRB-CESAB](https://www.fondationbiodiversite.fr/en/about-the-foundation/le-cesab/)
and the
[GdR EcoStat](https://sites.google.com/site/gdrecostat/), 
is to train researchers in reproducibility, software development and 
version control tools (e.g. `git`, `GitHub`, `Quarto`, `renv` & `Docker`), 
applied to biodiversity research.


## Program {.unnumbered}

**Monday**

- Welcome & Opening remarks
- Open Science & Reproducible research
- _Coffee break_
- Introduction to Positron
- Organizing your project as a research compendium
- _Hands-on session:_ Building my first research compendium
- _Lunch break_
- Refactoring scripts into functions
- _Hands-on session:_ Refactoring the research compendium scripts into functions
- The `DESCRIPTION` file
- _Hands-on session:_ Adding a `DESCRIPTION` file to your research compendium
- _Coffee break_
- Developing an R package



**Tuesday**

- Introduction to `git` – Part 1 (initialization & commits)
- _Hands-on session:_ Initializing and using `git` in your research compendium
- _Coffee break_
- Introduction to `git` – Part 2 (pushing to GitHub)
- _Hands-on session:_ Publishing your research compendium on GitHub
- _Lunch break_
- Optimizing your workflow with `{targets}`
- _Coffee break_
- _Hands-on session:_ Integrating `{targets}` into your research compendium



**Wednesday**

- Introduction to `git` – Part 3 (collaboration and conflict resolution)
- _Coffee break_
- _Hands-on session:_ Collaborating on the Same Project
- _Lunch break_
- Code hosting platforms: GitHub, GitLab & Codeberg
- Literate programming with Quarto
- _Coffee break_
- _Hands-on session:_ Adding Quarto to your research compendium



**Thursday**

- Managing packages and their versions with `{renv}`
- _Hands-on session:_ Adding `{renv}` to your research compendium
- _Coffee break_
- Containerizing your project with Docker
- Week recap and formation of project groups
- _Lunch break_
- Group projects



**Friday**

- Group projects
- Group project presentations



## Prerequisites {.unnumbered}

{{< fa hand-point-right >}}&nbsp; Please follow this [tutorial](https://frbcesab.github.io/rsetup/chapters/reproducible-research.html) to install 
your working environment **before attending the training course**.

{{< fa hand-point-right >}}&nbsp; You also need to create an account on [GitHub](https://github.com/signup/) (please edit your profile and enter your name).
